seed_taxonomy_rules.geometry_generation_seed: Controls procedural road geometry sampling (0..19). Frozen in geometry manifest.
seed_taxonomy_rules.environment_seed: Controls traffic spawn and simulator stochasticity for a fixed geometry. Test pool: 9101..9105.
seed_taxonomy_rules.agent_seed: Controls agent-side RNG (action sampling, weight init). Independent replicates: 101, 202, 303.
seed_taxonomy_rules.training_run_seed: Root seed for training replicates; training env seeds are derived deterministically via derive_seed().
seed_taxonomy_rules.protocol_order_seed: Fixed seed (424242) for deterministic test case shuffling across all algorithms.
